newsitem.title: UK: Timings and areas for UK natural gas deregulation.
newsitem.headline: Timings and areas for UK natural gas deregulation.

text.p: This is the complete list proposed by Britain's Department of Trade and Industry on Monday of areas which will be opened to domestic natural gas competition in the coming months.
Step 1 (from October this year, with Ofgas approval) - Scotland, Durham, Hartlepool, Middlesbrough, Northumberland, Redcar and Cleveland, Stockton-on-Tees, Tyne and Wear

Step 2 (from January 1998 if computer systems are ready; subsequent steps to run at monthly intervals) - Cumbria, Greater Manchester, Merseyside, City of Kingston-upon-Hull, Lancashire, the East Riding of Yorkshire, North Yorkshire, York
Step 3 - Cheshire, Derbyshire, North Lincolnshire, North East Lincolnshire, Nottinghamshire, Shropshire, Staffordshire, South Yorkshire, West Yorkshire
Step 4 - Wales, Gloucestershire, Hereford and Worcester, Leicestershire, Oxfordshire, Warwickshire, West Midlands, Wiltshire
Step 5 - Bedfordshire, Berkshire, Buckinghamshire, Cambridgeshire, Essex, Hampshire, Hertfordshire, Isle of Wight, Lincolnshire, Norfolk, Northamptonshire, Suffolk
